changelog: New voice command "delete last character" — say "delete last character" or "backspace" alone while dictating (or "শেষ অক্ষর মুছে ফেলো") and the last character before the cursor is deleted, so one wrong letter can be fixed by voice without tapping Backspace or deleting the whole word. It deletes one letter (a Bengali vowel sign goes with its letter; an emoji is never split). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
